evidence_required: Mechanism plus the throughput-loss arithmetic for a 256-GPU synchronous job.

marking.criterion: States that every synchronous step waits for the slowest rank in the collective
Computes the loss as about 10 % of the whole job (about 25.6 GPU-equivalents), not 10 %/256
Notes that the other 255 GPUs idle (spin in the collective) rather than doing useful work

title: Why one slow GPU slows the whole job
